# SnapFrame — Corporate About Landing Page

## Overview

Build a bold, modern corporate landing page for **SnapFrame**, a social media platform centered on photo and video sharing. This is the company's public-facing "About" page — think Instagram's corporate site energy. The audience spans general consumers, creators, parents, and businesses, so the page needs to feel approachable yet authoritative.

The vibe is **modern, bold, and playful**. Think vibrant gradient accents (purples, magentas, warm oranges — reminiscent of social media energy), clean sans-serif typography (Inter, Plus Jakarta Sans, or similar), generous whitespace, and rounded UI elements. The page should feel alive without being cluttered. Light background, high-contrast text, colorful accent moments.

## Key Priorities

**News carousel is the core interactive element.** The horizontally scrollable news section must feel smooth and intuitive — each card should display a thumbnail, category tag, title, and date. Make sure it's swipeable on mobile and scrollable on desktop. This is the most important interaction to get right.

**Responsive design with a working hamburger menu.** The mobile navigation toggle is essential — the header should collapse into a hamburger icon on smaller screens that reveals the full nav when tapped.

**The footer is dense and structured.** It's organized into multiple columns (About, Features, Safety, Community, plus external links). Treat it as a serious navigation hub — clean grid layout, legible at small sizes.

**Hero section sets the tone.** Lead with energy — a compelling headline, the one-liner value prop, and a prominent "Try it now" CTA. Consider a bold background image or gradient treatment.

The safety and creators sections should feel distinct — safety conveys trust and care (softer tones), while creators should feel aspirational and dynamic.

Refer to `task_input.json` for the exact section order, navigation links, interaction specs, and data display requirements.

---

## Data Sources

1. Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md` for all content materials (text, data).
2. Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json` for structural requirements, data placement, and interaction definitions.

## Output Requirements

1. Output all files to `/app/output/`. `index.html` must be the main entry point.
2. All pages must be openable directly in a browser (no build step needed). Use relative paths for inter-page links.

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — make professional judgments autonomously. Do not pause, ask questions, or wait for replies.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies `site.tone`, `site.audience`, etc., use them to choose styles, layouts, and color schemes. Otherwise, make professional judgments.
3. **Priority** — these rules override any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The skill's workflow, quality standards, and technical specs remain fully effective — only skip interactive waits.

      --gray-200: #e5e5ea;
      --gray-400: #a0a0b0;
      --gray-600: #6e6e82;
      --gray-800: #1c1c2e;
      --radius-sm: 8px;
      --radius-md: 16px;
      --radius-lg: 24px;
      --radius-xl: 32px;
    }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    body {
      font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
      background: var(--white);
      color: var(--gray-800);
      line-height: 1.6;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }

    a { text-decoration: none; color: inherit; }
    button { cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; border: none; background: none; }
    img { display: block; max-width: 100%; }

    /* ─── HEADER ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .header {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.92);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
    }

    .header-inner {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 24px;
      height: 68px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      color: var(--black);
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }

    .logo-icon {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple), var(--orange));
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .logo-icon svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: white; }

    .header-right {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .btn-login {
      padding: 8px 22px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      background: var(--black);
      color: var(--white);
      transition: opacity 0.15s;
    }
    .btn-login:hover { opacity: 0.8; }

    /* hamburger */
    .hamburger {
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 5px;
      padding: 8px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      transition: background 0.15s;
    }
    .hamburger:hover { background: var(--gray-100); }
    .hamburger span {
      display: block;
      width: 22px;
      height: 2px;
      background: var(--black);
      border-radius: 2px;
      transition: transform 0.25s, opacity 0.25s;
    }
    .hamburger.open span:nth-child(1) { transform: translateY(7px) rotate(45deg); }
    .hamburger.open span:nth-child(2) { opacity: 0; }
    .hamburger.open span:nth-child(3) { transform: translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg); }

    /* mobile nav overlay */
    .mobile-nav {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      inset: 68px 0 0 0;
      background: var(--white);
      z-index: 99;
      padding: 32px 24px;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      animation: slideDown 0.2s ease;
    }
    .mobile-nav.open { display: flex; }

    @keyframes slideDown {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-8px); }
      to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }

    .mobile-nav a {
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 14px 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
      color: var(--gray-800);
      transition: color 0.15s;
    }
    .mobile-nav a:hover { color: var(--purple); }

    .mobile-nav .btn-login-mobile {
      margin-top: 16px;
      padding: 14px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      background: var(--black);
      color: var(--white);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1rem;
      text-align: center;
    }

    /* ─── HERO ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .hero {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 90vh;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .hero-bg {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    /* Abstract gradient blobs */
    .hero-blob {
      position: absolute;
      border-radius: 50%;
      filter: blur(80px);
      opacity: 0.35;
    }
    .hero-blob-1 {
      width: 600px; height: 600px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, #9B6BFF, transparent);
      top: -100px; right: -80px;
    }
    .hero-blob-2 {
      width: 480px; height: 480px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, #FF9A40, transparent);
      bottom: -60px; left: -60px;
    }
    .hero-blob-3 {
      width: 300px; height: 300px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, #FF7A00, transparent);
      top: 40%; right: 30%;
      opacity: 0.2;
    }

    /* Grid dot pattern */
    .hero-grid {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background-image: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(118,56,250,0.12) 1px, transparent 1px);
      background-size: 40px 40px;
      z-index: 0;
    }

    .hero-inner {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 80px 24px;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 64px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .hero-content {}

    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      padding: 6px 14px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      background: var(--purple-faint);
      color: var(--purple);
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
    }
    .hero-badge::before {
      content: '';
      width: 6px; height: 6px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--purple);
    }

    .hero-title {
      font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 5.5vw, 4.2rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.08;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      color: var(--black);
      margin-bottom: 28px;
    }

    .hero-title .accent-purple { color: var(--purple); }
    .hero-title .accent-orange { color: var(--orange); }

    .hero-sub {
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      max-width: 480px;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    .btn-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 16px 36px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 1rem;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple), #a855f7);
      color: var(--white);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(118,56,250,0.35);
      transition: transform 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s;
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    }
    .btn-cta:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(118,56,250,0.45);
    }
    .btn-cta:active { transform: translateY(0); }

    .hero-visual {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: center;
    }

    /* Phone mockup cluster */
    .phone-cluster {
      position: relative;
      width: 340px;
      height: 480px;
    }

    .phone-card {
      position: absolute;
      border-radius: 24px;
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.18);
    }

    .phone-card-main {
      width: 200px;
      height: 360px;
      left: 50%;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, #7638FA 0%, #FF7A00 100%);
      z-index: 3;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      padding: 20px;
    }

    .phone-card-left {
      width: 160px;
      height: 280px;
      left: -10px;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%) rotate(-8deg);
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, #1c1c2e 0%, #3a2060 100%);
      z-index: 2;
    }

    .phone-card-right {
      width: 160px;
      height: 280px;
      right: -10px;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%) rotate(8deg);
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, #FF7A00 0%, #FFD166 100%);
      z-index: 2;
    }

    .phone-notch {
      width: 60px;
      height: 8px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      border-radius: 4px;
      margin: 0 auto 20px;
    }

    .phone-img-placeholder {
      flex: 1;
      border-radius: 14px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .phone-img-placeholder svg {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      fill: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
    }

    .phone-stat {
      margin-top: 12px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 8px 12px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .phone-stat-dot {
      width: 8px; height: 8px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--orange-light);
    }

    .phone-stat-text {
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    /* Floating badges */
    .float-badge {
      position: absolute;
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: 14px;
      padding: 10px 14px;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--gray-800);
      z-index: 10;
    }

    .float-badge-1 {
      top: 20px;
      left: -20px;
    }

    .float-badge-2 {
      bottom: 30px;
      right: -20px;
    }

    .float-badge .badge-icon {
      width: 28px; height: 28px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 1rem;
    }

    .float-badge-1 .badge-icon { background: var(--purple-faint); }
    .float-badge-2 .badge-icon { background: var(--orange-faint); }

    /* ─── SECTION COMMONS ────────────────────────────────── */
    .section {
      padding: 96px 0;
    }

    .container {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 24px;
    }

    .section-label {
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .section-title {
      font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3.5vw, 2.8rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.15;
      letter-spacing: -0.025em;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .section-desc {
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      max-width: 560px;
      line-height: 1.75;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }

    .link-arrow {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      transition: gap 0.15s;
    }
    .link-arrow:hover { gap: 8px; }

    /* ─── FEATURES ───────────────────────────────────────── */
    .features {
      background: var(--gray-50);
    }

    .features-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 64px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .features-label { color: var(--purple); }
    .features-title { color: var(--black); }
    .features-link { color: var(--purple); }

    .features-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .feature-pill {
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 20px;
      transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s, transform 0.15s;
    }

    .feature-pill:hover {
      border-color: var(--purple);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(118,56,250,0.12);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    .feature-pill-icon {
      width: 44px; height: 44px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 1.3rem;
    }

    .feature-pill-name {
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      color: var(--black);
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .feature-pill-desc {
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    /* ─── SAFETY ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .safety {
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .safety-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 64px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .safety-label { color: #22c55e; }
    .safety-link { color: #16a34a; }

    .safety-visual {
      position: relative;
    }

    .safety-card-wrap {
      position: relative;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      overflow: hidden;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f0fdf4, #dcfce7, #bbf7d0);
      padding: 40px;
      min-height: 360px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .safety-shield {
      width: 72px; height: 72px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: #22c55e;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .safety-shield svg {
      width: 36px; height: 36px;
      fill: white;
    }

    .safety-feature-chip {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      background: white;
      border-radius: 100px;
      padding: 10px 16px;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--gray-800);
      box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.07);
    }

    .safety-feature-chip .chip-dot {
      width: 8px; height: 8px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: #22c55e;
    }

    /* ─── CREATORS ───────────────────────────────────────── */
    .creators {
      background: var(--black);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .creators-bg-blob-1 {
      position: absolute;
      width: 500px; height: 500px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(118,56,250,0.3), transparent);
      top: -100px; right: -100px;
      filter: blur(60px);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .creators-bg-blob-2 {
      position: absolute;
      width: 400px; height: 400px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,122,0,0.25), transparent);
      bottom: -80px; left: -60px;
      filter: blur(60px);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .creators-inner {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 64px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .creators-label { color: var(--orange); }
    .creators-title { color: var(--white); }
    .creators-desc { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65); }
    .creators-link { color: var(--orange); }

    .creators-visual {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .creator-card {
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      overflow: hidden;
      aspect-ratio: 4/5;
      position: relative;
    }

    .creator-card-bg {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
    }

    .creator-card:nth-child(1) .creator-card-bg {
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, #7638FA 0%, #c084fc 100%);
    }
    .creator-card:nth-child(2) .creator-card-bg {
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, #FF7A00 0%, #FFD166 100%);
      margin-top: 28px;
    }
    .creator-card:nth-child(3) .creator-card-bg {
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, #1c1c2e 0%, #7638FA 100%);
    }
    .creator-card:nth-child(4) .creator-card-bg {
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, #FF7A00 0%, #ff4d4d 100%);
      margin-top: -28px;
    }

    .creator-card-inner {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      padding: 16px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: flex-end;
    }

    .creator-avatar {
      width: 36px; height: 36px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
      border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 1rem;
    }

    .creator-stat {
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
      font-weight: 600;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
      padding: 4px 8px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      display: inline-block;
    }

    .creator-icon-center {
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      font-size: 2.5rem;
      opacity: 0.5;
    }

    /* ─── TAGLINE BANNER ─────────────────────────────────── */
    .tagline-banner {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple) 0%, var(--orange) 100%);
      padding: 72px 24px;
      text-align: center;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .tagline-banner::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg width='60' height='60' viewBox='0 0 60 60' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cg fill='none' fill-rule='evenodd'%3E%3Cg fill='%23ffffff' fill-opacity='0.06'%3E%3Ccircle cx='30' cy='30' r='1'/%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E");
    }

    .tagline-text {
      position: relative;
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4.5vw, 3.6rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--white);
      letter-spacing: -0.025em;
      line-height: 1.15;
      max-width: 700px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    /* ─── NEWS ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .news {
      background: var(--white);
      padding-bottom: 80px;
    }

    .news-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .news-header-left {}

    .news-label { color: var(--purple); }
    .news-title { color: var(--black); margin-bottom: 0; }

    .news-view-more {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      color: var(--purple);
      border: 2px solid var(--purple);
      border-radius: 100px;
      padding: 8px 20px;
      transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .news-view-more:hover {
      background: var(--purple);
      color: var(--white);
    }

    /* Carousel */
    .carousel-wrapper {
      position: relative;
    }

    .carousel {
      display: flex;
      gap: 20px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
      -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
      padding: 8px 4px 20px;
      scrollbar-width: none;
    }
    .carousel::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

    .news-card {
      flex: 0 0 300px;
      scroll-snap-align: start;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--gray-200);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .news-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.10);
    }

    .news-thumbnail {
      width: 100%;
      aspect-ratio: 16/9;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .news-thumb-bg {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .news-card:nth-child(1) .news-thumb-bg {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7638FA, #c084fc);
    }
    .news-card:nth-child(2) .news-thumb-bg {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FF7A00, #FFD166);
    }
    .news-card:nth-child(3) .news-thumb-bg {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1c1c2e, #7638FA);
    }
    .news-card:nth-child(4) .news-thumb-bg {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #16a34a, #4ade80);
    }

    .news-thumb-icon {
      font-size: 2.5rem;
      opacity: 0.6;
    }

    .news-card-body {
      padding: 20px;
    }

    .news-tags {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 6px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .news-tag {
      font-size: 0.68rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      color: var(--purple);
      background: var(--purple-faint);
      border-radius: 100px;
      padding: 3px 10px;
    }

    .news-tag.tag-orange {
      color: var(--orange);
      background: var(--orange-faint);
    }

    .news-tag.tag-green {
      color: #16a34a;
      background: #f0fdf4;
    }

    .news-card-title {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--black);
      line-height: 1.45;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      display: -webkit-box;
      -webkit-line-clamp: 3;
      -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .news-card-date {
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* Scroll arrows */
    .carousel-arrow {
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      width: 44px; height: 44px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--gray-200);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;

  // ── Hamburger menu ───────────────────────────────────────
  const hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');
  const mobileNav = document.getElementById('mobileNav');

  hamburger.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const isOpen = mobileNav.classList.toggle('open');
    hamburger.classList.toggle('open', isOpen);
    hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(isOpen));
    document.body.style.overflow = isOpen ? 'hidden' : '';
  });

  // Close mobile nav when a link is clicked
  mobileNav.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(link => {
    link.addEventListener('click', () => {
      mobileNav.classList.remove('open');
      hamburger.classList.remove('open');
      hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    });
  });

  // ── News carousel ────────────────────────────────────────
  const carousel = document.getElementById('newsCarousel');
  const prevBtn  = document.getElementById('carouselPrev');
  const nextBtn  = document.getElementById('carouselNext');
  const SCROLL_AMOUNT = 320;

  prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    carousel.scrollBy({ left: -SCROLL_AMOUNT, behavior: 'smooth' });
  });

  nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    carousel.scrollBy({ left: SCROLL_AMOUNT, behavior: 'smooth' });
  });

  // Hide/show arrows based on scroll position
  function updateArrows() {
    prevBtn.style.opacity = carousel.scrollLeft <= 8 ? '0.35' : '1';
    prevBtn.style.pointerEvents = carousel.scrollLeft <= 8 ? 'none' : 'auto';
    const atEnd = carousel.scrollLeft + carousel.clientWidth >= carousel.scrollWidth - 8;
    nextBtn.style.opacity = atEnd ? '0.35' : '1';
    nextBtn.style.pointerEvents = atEnd ? 'none' : 'auto';
  }

  carousel.addEventListener('scroll', updateArrows, { passive: true });
  updateArrows();
</script>

    /* ─── TAGLINE BANNER ─────────────────────────────────── */

    /* ─── NEWS ───────────────────────────────────────────── */

    .carousel {

    .news-card:nth-child(3) .news-thumb-bg {

    .news-card-body {

    }

    .news-tags {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 6px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .news-tag {
      font-size: 0.68rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      color: var(--purple);
      background: var(--purple-faint);
      border-radius: 100px;
      padding: 3px 10px;

    .news-tag.tag-orange {
      color: var(--orange);
      background: var(--orange-faint);
    }

    .news-tag.tag-green {
      color: #16a34a;
      background: #f0fdf4;
    }

    .news-card-title {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--black);
      line-height: 1.45;

      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .news-card-date {
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* Scroll arrows */
    .carousel-arrow {
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      width: 44px; height: 44px;
      border-radius: 50%;

      border: 1.5px solid var(--gray-200);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
      cursor: pointer;
      z-index: 5;
      transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s;
    }

    .carousel-arrow:hover {
      background: var(--black);
      border-color: var(--black);
    }

    .carousel-arrow:hover svg { stroke: white; }

    .carousel-arrow svg {
      width: 18px; height: 18px;
      stroke: var(--gray-800);
      fill: none;
      stroke-width: 2;
      stroke-linecap: round;
      stroke-linejoin: round;

    .arrow-prev { left: -22px; }
    .arrow-next { right: -22px; }

    /* ─── CTA DOWNLOAD ───────────────────────────────────── */

      background: var(--gray-50);
      padding: 96px 24px;
      text-align: center;

    .cta-download-inner {
      max-width: 600px;
      margin: 0 auto;

    .cta-download-headline {
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3.2rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.025em;
      color: var(--black);
      margin-bottom: 4px;

    .cta-download-sub {
      font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3.5vw, 2.8rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.025em;

    .store-buttons {

    .store-btn-text {

    .store-btn-sub {

      font-weight: 800;

    .footer-col ul li a {

    .footer-col ul li a:hover {

      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 16px;

    }

    .footer-lang-select {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;

      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;

      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s;

    .social-icon:hover {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.18);
      color: var(--white);
    }

    /* ─── RESPONSIVE ─────────────────────────────────────── */
    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .hamburger { display: flex; }

      .header-right .btn-login { display: none; }

      .hero-inner {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 48px;
        padding: 60px 24px;
        text-align: center;
      }

      .hero-sub { margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; }
      .btn-cta { margin: 0 auto; }

      .hero-visual { display: none; }

      .features-inner,
      .safety-inner,
      .creators-inner {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 40px;
      }

      .safety-visual,
      .creators-visual {
        order: -1;
      }

      .features-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }

      .news-header {
        flex-direction: column;

    @media (max-width: 480px) {

      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
      .store-buttons { flex-direction: column; align-items: center; }
    }
  </style>
</head>

    hamburger.classList.toggle('open', isOpen);
    hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(isOpen));
    document.body.style.overflow = isOpen ? 'hidden' : '';
  });

  // Close mobile nav when a link is clicked
  mobileNav.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(link => {
    link.addEventListener('click', () => {
      mobileNav.classList.remove('open');
      hamburger.classList.remove('open');
      hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    });
  });

  // ── News carousel ────────────────────────────────────────
  const carousel = document.getElementById('newsCarousel');
  const prevBtn  = document.getElementById('carouselPrev');
  const nextBtn  = document.getElementById('carouselNext');
  const SCROLL_AMOUNT = 320;

  prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    carousel.scrollBy({ left: -SCROLL_AMOUNT, behavior: 'smooth' });
  });

  nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    carousel.scrollBy({ left: SCROLL_AMOUNT, behavior: 'smooth' });
  });

  // Hide/show arrows based on scroll position
  function updateArrows() {
    prevBtn.style.opacity = carousel.scrollLeft <= 8 ? '0.35' : '1';
    prevBtn.style.pointerEvents = carousel.scrollLeft <= 8 ? 'none' : 'auto';
    const atEnd = carousel.scrollLeft + carousel.clientWidth >= carousel.scrollWidth - 8;
    nextBtn.style.opacity = atEnd ? '0.35' : '1';
    nextBtn.style.pointerEvents = atEnd ? 'none' : 'auto';
